races.office: Soil and Water Conservation District Commissioner
Iowa Township Trustee, To Fill Vacancy - 2 Year Term

measures.name: Public Measure "A"
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Wright County Board of Supervisors fill the offices of trustees and clerk of Iowa Township by appointment as the terms of office of the incumbent township officers expire?

measures.name: Public Measure "B"
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Wright County Board of Supervisors fill the offices of trustees and clerk of Wall Lake Township by appointment as the terms of office of the incumbent township officers expire?

measures.name: Public Measure "C"
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Wright County Board of Supervisors fill the offices of trustees and clerk of Woolstock Township by appointment as the terms of office of the incumbent township officers expire?

notes: Source: 13 per-precinct official sample ballot PDFs (text-extractable). Board of Supervisors District 1 and District 5 contests appear on every precinct ballot countywide, i.e. elected at-large with district residency (all voters see both). Township offices appear only on the Iowa Township (102), Wall Lake Township (402) and Woolstock Township (403) ballots; the Rural Clarion (300) and Rural Eagle Grove (900) ballots carry no township offices. Each of those three townships also votes on a public measure to have the Board of Supervisors fill township trustee/clerk offices by appointment.
